name: AI Prompt Manager
desc: Save, organize, and quickly reuse AI prompts. Categorize by model, tag system, search/filter, export to markdown, copy to clipboard. Full terminal UI.

name: Bulk Image Resizer
desc: Resize hundreds of images at once. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF. Progress bar, folder watch mode, quality settings.

name: auto-vpn-killswitch
desc: VPN killswitch for Linux using iptables/nftables. Supports WireGuard and OpenVPN. Auto-reconnect, logging, desktop notifications.

name: bash-obfuscator
desc: Obfuscate bash scripts - variable randomization, base64 encoding, comment stripping, dead code injection. Outputs unreadable but functional .sh files.

name: duplicate-file-finder
desc: Finds and removes duplicate files using: exact byte comparison (not just hash), fuzzy name matching, content similarity (for near-duplicates). Features: dry-run mode, auto-clean with confirmation, move to quarantine folder, save report as HTML with previews. Handles millions of files efficiently.

name: encrypted-file-wiper
desc: Securely deletes files beyond recovery. Passes: overwrite with random data (1-35 passes), rename to random string, truncate, delete. Supports: file shred, free space wipe, entire drive wipe. Reports verification with hexdump to confirm destruction. Includes DoD 5220.22-M and Gutmann methods.

name: filesystem-watcher
desc: Watch directories for changes and trigger actions. Features: real-time file change detection, auto-backup modified files to a timestamped archive, rsync integration, exclusions, email notification on changes above threshold.

name: log-analyzer
desc: Parse and analyze log files (syslog, auth.log, apache, nginx, docker). Features: pattern detection, error frequency charts in terminal, IP geolocation, timeline view, export as HTML report. Color-coded output.
